---
title: "CHIP classification"
date: 2026-09-27
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
  message: false
---

The SAP prespecifies the proportion of ctDNA variants suspected of CHIP. This
export supports a descriptive classification from matched solid-biopsy and
buffy-coat findings. Mutations detected in both are shown separately as
possible germline variants. For ctDNA-only mutations without buffy-coat
sequencing, the proportion is shown under both CHIP assumptions.

```{r}
#| label: chip-classification

source(here::here("R", "actionability.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data-helpers.R"))

alterations_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-alterations.parquet"
)
samples_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-ctdna-samples.parquet"
)
result_dir <- here::here("analysis", "04-implementation", "results")
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

alterations <- arrow::read_parquet(alterations_path) |>
  as.data.frame()
samples <- arrow::read_parquet(samples_path) |>
  as.data.frame()
valid_mutations <- alterations[
  alterations$alteration_type == "mutation" &
    alterations$valid_ctdna_result %in% TRUE,
]
valid_mutations$chip_classification <- classify_chip_status(valid_mutations)
assumption_eligible <- valid_mutations$chip_classification %in% c(
  "definite_chip", "definite_non_chip", "tissue_positive_buffy_missing",
  "ctdna_only_unknown"
)

class_labels <- c(
  definite_chip = "CHIP: buffy-coat positive, solid-biopsy negative",
  definite_non_chip = "Non-CHIP: buffy-coat negative",
  tissue_positive_buffy_missing =
    "Non-CHIP: solid-biopsy positive, buffy-coat sequencing missing",
  possible_germline = "Possible germline: positive in tissue and buffy coat",
  ctdna_only_unknown =
    "Uncertain: ctDNA-only, buffy-coat sequencing missing",
  unresolved = "Unresolved: other missing evidence"
)
valid_records <- nrow(valid_mutations)
chip_status_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(class_labels), function(status) {
  rows <- valid_mutations[
    valid_mutations$chip_classification == status, , drop = FALSE
  ]
  data.frame(
    classification = unname(class_labels[[status]]),
    mutation_records = nrow(rows),
    unique_variants = length(unique(rows$variant_id[!is.na(rows$variant_id)])),
    patients = length(unique(rows$id[!is.na(rows$id)])),
    percent_of_valid_mutations = if (valid_records == 0L) NA_real_ else
      100 * nrow(rows) / valid_records,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
chip_status_summary$valid_mutation_records <- valid_records

valid_patients <- unique(samples$id[
  samples$valid_ctdna_result %in% TRUE & !is.na(samples$id)
])
assumptions <- c(
  "Assume ctDNA-only unknowns are not CHIP",
  "Assume ctDNA-only unknowns are CHIP"
)
chip_assumption_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(assumptions), function(i) {
  include_unknown <- i == 2L
  chip_rows <- assumption_eligible & (
    valid_mutations$chip_classification == "definite_chip" |
      (include_unknown &
         valid_mutations$chip_classification == "ctdna_only_unknown")
  )
  chip_ids <- unique(valid_mutations$id[chip_rows & !is.na(valid_mutations$id)])
  data.frame(
    assumption = assumptions[[i]],
    chip_mutations = sum(chip_rows),
    assumption_eligible_mutation_records = sum(assumption_eligible),
    chip_mutation_percent = if (!any(assumption_eligible)) NA_real_ else
      100 * sum(chip_rows) / sum(assumption_eligible),
    patients_with_chip_mutation = length(chip_ids),
    valid_ctdna_patients = length(valid_patients),
    patients_with_chip_percent = if (length(valid_patients) == 0L) NA_real_ else
      100 * length(chip_ids) / length(valid_patients),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

arrow::write_parquet(
  chip_status_summary,
  file.path(result_dir, "chip-status-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
arrow::write_parquet(
  chip_assumption_summary,
  file.path(result_dir, "chip-assumption-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: chip-status-table
#| tbl-cap: "ctDNA mutation classification using solid-biopsy and buffy-coat findings"
#| echo: false

chip_status_summary |>
  dplyr::select(
    classification,
    mutation_records,
    percent_of_valid_mutations,
    unique_variants,
    patients
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 1)
```

```{r}
#| label: chip-assumption-table
#| tbl-cap: "Proportion of valid ctDNA mutations classified as CHIP under two assumptions"
#| echo: false

chip_assumption_summary |>
  dplyr::select(
    assumption,
    chip_mutations,
    assumption_eligible_mutation_records,
    chip_mutation_percent,
    patients_with_chip_mutation,
    valid_ctdna_patients,
    patients_with_chip_percent
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 1)
```
